# CSS Class Name Generator

Generate BEM-compliant CSS class names.

## BEM Convention
- Block: standalone component (e.g., `card`)
- Element: part of block (e.g., `card__title`)
- Modifier: variation (e.g., `card--highlighted`)

## Rules
- Use lowercase letters and hyphens
- No camelCase in class names
- Maximum 3 levels of nesting
- Prefer composition over deep nesting
